origine_fr: Le lit du malade 疒 : tout le peuple tombe malade. Dedans, 殳 reste d'un caractère qui donnait le son ; il se lit shū et ne le donne plus. La maladie qui frappe tout le monde, c'est l'épidémie ; 疫苗 est le vaccin.
origine_en: The sickbed, 疒: a whole people falling ill. Inside, 殳 is what remains of a character that gave the sound; it is read shū and no longer gives it. An illness that strikes everyone is an epidemic; 疫苗 is a vaccine.

phrase.en: The child needs to get vaccinated.
